teaser: Monstream, briefed: AI research streams with a clean integration API, and how our newsrooms could use, check and contribute to it.
core_idea: Monstream, run by the small encryption company Fair Math, turns described topics into rules that AI agents apply to sources continuously; with no public pricing but a careful integration API of streams by our own id, signed webhooks and feedback, it can feed our newsrooms leads through the API only, while our own captures, checks and verdicts remain the evidence.

quotes.text: Monstream widens what we see; our captures decide what we say.
It is a clean, careful design: idempotent, signed, scoped, and built around the caller's own ids.
